Package it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui

Class SetupGUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.SetupGUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReconnectableView, SetupView
public class SetupGUI extends Object implements SetupView
Used when the client chooses to play the GUI version of the game; this class represents the GUI for the player reception phase, before entering an actual game.
